stance_basis: letter praises the EIS as complete and concise without objecting to or endorsing the project
summary: The Iowa Conservation Commission reviewed the draft environmental statement and found it to be a complete and concise document addressing environmental, social, and economic issues. Their letter is brief and complimentary, noting they will make copies available to the public, and expresses no objections or conditions regarding the proposed ORV regulations.
complaint_summary: The Iowa Conservation Commission reports that its Planning Section found the draft EIS to be a complete and concise statement covering environmental, social, and economic issues, and confirms copies will be made available to the public.

statement.text:
Our Planning Section has just reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on public lands. They report this to be a complete and concise statement dealing not only with the environmental, but also social, and economic issues as well.
As you have requested, copies of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle Report will be made available to the public for review in this office.
We appreciate your cooperation in allowing us to review this document.
Sincerely,
Fred A. Priewert, Director Iowa Conservation Commission
